name: geo-datasync-fi
description: Tooling for working with Finnish open geospatial data.

plugins.name: fi-open-geodata
plugins.description: Make Finnish open data spatially interoperable: CRS detection and correction, conversion to EUREF-FIN / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067), join-key normalisation against National Land Survey and Statistics Finland reference layers, address geocoding, and INSPIRE ISO 19139 metadata.
